integrity: The primary source supplies the universal homogeneous ultrametric graph, its canonical metric levels, strict homogeneity, and finite-extension property. The new deduction is limited to the exact graph-enriched binary orbital decomposition.
scientific_limitations: Only ordered-pair orbits and the corresponding point-stabilizer point-orbits are classified; higher-arity tuple orbits are not analyzed.
The deduction from strict homogeneity is short, so an unindexed or folklore statement may exist.
The older pure-ultrametric arity theorem is contextual prior art and is not claimed as part of the new contribution.
title: Exact binary orbit spectrum of the ultrametric random graph
